title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: 《简·爱》是夏洛蒂·勃朗特（Charlotte Brontë）于 1847 年以笔名“库瑞尔·贝尔”出版的自传体长篇小说。孤儿简·爱从小在舅妈家受尽虐待，后被送往规矩苛刻的罗伍德义学。恪守尊严与独立的简·爱通过自身努力应聘成为桑菲尔德庄园的家庭教师，并与庄园主罗切斯特先生（Mr. Rochester）产生了深厚真挚的爱情。然而在婚礼当天，罗切斯特隐瞒疯妻的秘密被揭穿。面对道德与情感的抉择，简·爱毅然选择离开。全书展现了女性追求平等、尊严与灵魂自由的强大意志力，是英语学习者不可错过的励志名著。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Gateshead Hall and the Red-Room
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：盖茨黑德庄园与红房子

paragraphs.en: There was no possibility of taking a walk that day. We had been wandering, indeed, in the leafless shrubbery an hour in the morning; but since dinner (Mrs. Reed, when there was no company, dined early) the cold winter wind had brought with it clouds so sombre, and a rain so penetrating, that further outdoor exercise was now out of the question.
paragraphs.zh: 那天不可能散步了。事实上，我们在早晨在无叶的灌木丛里漫步了一个小时；但自从午饭后（里德太太在没有客人时吃得早），寒冷的冬风带来了如此阴沉的云彩，以及如此具有穿透力的雨水，以至于进一步的户外活动现在是不可能的了。

paragraphs.en: I was glad of it: I never liked long walks, especially on chilly afternoons: dreadful to me was the coming home in the raw twilight, with nipped fingers and toes, and a heart saddened by the chidings of Bessie, the nurse, and humbled by the consciousness of my physical inferiority to John, Eliza, and Georgiana Reed.
paragraphs.zh: 我为此感到高兴：我从来不喜欢长途散步，尤其是在寒冷的下午：对我来说可怕的是在湿冷的黄昏回家，手指和脚趾被冻伤，心因护士贝茜的训斥而悲伤，因感到自己在身体上劣于约翰、伊丽莎白和乔治安娜·里德而感到卑微。

paragraphs.en: The said John, Eliza, and Georgiana were now clustered round their mama in the drawing-room: she lay reclined on a sofa by the fireside, and with her darlings about her (for the time neither quarrelling nor crying) looked perfectly happy.
paragraphs.zh: 前面提到的约翰、伊丽莎白和乔治安娜现在聚集在客厅里他们的妈妈周围：她斜靠在火炉旁的沙发上，她的宝贝们在她身边（当时既不争吵也不哭泣），看起来非常幸福。

paragraphs.en: Me, she had dispensed from joining the group; saying, "She regretted to be under the necessity of keeping me at a distance; but that until she heard from Bessie and could discover by her own observation that I was endeavouring in good earnest to acquire a more sociable and childlike disposition, a more attractive and sprightly manner—something lighter, franker, more natural, as it were—she really must exclude me from privileges intended only for contented, happy, little children."
paragraphs.zh: 我被免于加入这个群体；她说：“她很遗憾不得不保持我的距离；但直到她从贝茜那里听说，并能通过她自己的观察发现，我正在认真地努力获得一种更有社交性和孩子气的性格，一种更有吸引力和活泼的举止——可以说更轻快、更坦率、更自然的东西——她真的必须把我排除在仅为满意、快乐的小孩准备的特权之外。”

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Red-Room Punishment
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：红房子的惩罚与绝望

paragraphs.en: The red-room was a cold room, because it seldom had a fire; it was silent, because remote from the nursery and kitchen; solemn, because it was so seldom entered.
paragraphs.zh: 红房子是一间寒冷的房间，因为它很少烧火；它是安静的，因为它远离育儿室和厨房；它是庄严的，因为它很少有人进来。

paragraphs.en: The bed supported on massive pillars of mahogany, hung with curtains of deep red damask, stood out like a tabernacle in the centre; the two large windows, with their blinds always drawn down, were half shrouded in festoons and falls of similar drapery.
paragraphs.zh: 床由红木的大柱子支撑着，挂着深红色锦缎的窗帘，在中央像一个圣幕一样突出；两扇大窗户的百叶窗总是拉下来，半遮在类似织物的花彩和垂挂中。

paragraphs.en: It was in this room that Mr. Reed had died nine years ago; and his last moments, his dying words, his quiet lying in state, had given to the place a cold, solemn dread.
paragraphs.zh: 九年前里德先生就是在这个房间里去世的；他的最后时刻，他的临终遗言，他安静地停灵，给这个地方带来了一种寒冷、庄严的恐惧。

paragraphs.en: I sat in a chair by the bedside, trembling with cold and fear, watching the shadows lengthen across the carpet as twilight deepened into night.
paragraphs.zh: 我坐在床边的一张椅子上，因寒冷和害怕而发抖，看着随着黄昏加深为夜晚，阴影在地毯上延长。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, a beam of light glided up the wall and hovered over my head. My heart beat thick, my head grew hot; a sound filled my ears which I deemed the rushing of wings; something seemed near me; I was oppressed, suffocated: my endurance broke; I rushed to the door and shook the lock in desperate panic.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一束光沿着墙壁滑过，悬挂在我的头上。我的心猛烈跳动，我的头变热了；一种声音填满了我的耳朵，我以为是翅膀的喧嚣；某种东西似乎在我附近；我感到被压迫、窒息：我的忍耐力崩溃了；我冲向门口，在绝望的恐慌中摇晃着锁。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Mr. Lloyd and the Proposal of School
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：洛伊德医生与上学倡议

paragraphs.en: The next thing I remember is, waking up with a feeling as if I had had a frightful nightmare, and seeing before me a terrible red glare, crossed with thick black bars.
paragraphs.zh: 我记得的下一件事是醒来，感觉好像做了一场可怕的噩梦，看到面前有一个可怕的红色强光，交叉着厚厚的黑条。

paragraphs.en: I heard voices, too, speaking with a hollow sound, and as if muffled by a cotton wool atmosphere; I was in bed, and my bed had curtains of chintz.
paragraphs.zh: 我也听到声音，说话带着空洞的声音，仿佛被棉花包裹的气氛所掩盖；我在床上，我的床有印花布的窗帘。

paragraphs.en: Beside me stood an apothecary, Mr. Lloyd, whom Mrs. Reed sometimes called in for the servants when they were ill.
paragraphs.zh: 我身边站着一个药剂师洛伊德先生，里德太太在仆人们生病时偶尔会请他来。

paragraphs.en: "Well, who am I?" he asked, looking down at me with a kindly, humorous eye.
paragraphs.zh: “嗯，我是谁？”他问，用一种温和、幽默的眼睛看着我。

paragraphs.en: "You are Mr. Lloyd, the apothecary," I answered softly.
paragraphs.zh: “你是药剂师洛伊德先生，”我轻声回答。

paragraphs.en: He checked my pulse, looked at my tongue, and then turned to Bessie. "She has had a severe shock," he remarked calmly. "What caused it?"
paragraphs.zh: 他检查了我的脉搏，看了看我的舌头，然后转向贝茜。“她受了严重的惊吓，”他平静地备注道。“是什么引起的？”

paragraphs.en: "She fell down in a fit," Bessie replied.
paragraphs.zh: “她抽风倒下了，”贝茜回答。

paragraphs.en: "No, Bessie," I cried out from the bed, "it was because they locked me up in the red-room where Mr. Reed died!"
paragraphs.zh: “不，贝茜，”我在床上喊道，“是因为他们把我锁在了里德先生去世的红房子里！”

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Departure for Lowood School
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：告别盖茨黑德前往学校

paragraphs.en: A month elapsed after Mr. Lloyd's visit before any further step was taken regarding my future.
paragraphs.zh: 洛伊德先生拜访后过了一个月，关于我的未来才采取了进一步的措施。

paragraphs.en: One morning in January, Mrs. Reed called me into the breakfast-room. Standing by the hearth was a tall, rigid gentleman dressed in solemn black. His face was like a carved mask, with cold gray eyes under heavy brows.
paragraphs.zh: 一月的一个早晨，里德太太叫我进早餐室。站在火炉旁的是一位身穿庄严黑色西装的高大、僵硬的绅士。他的脸像雕刻的面具，厚眉毛下有一对冷酷的灰色眼睛。

paragraphs.en: "This is Little Jane Eyre, Mr. Brocklehurst," Mrs. Reed said, pointing her finger at me.
paragraphs.zh: “这是小简·爱，博克勒赫斯特先生，”里德太太指着我指着说。

paragraphs.en: The gentleman examined me with a long, deliberate stare. "Her size is small," he remarked. "What is her age?"
paragraphs.zh: 绅士用漫长、审慎的凝视检查了我。“她的身材很小，”他备注道。“她的年龄是多少？”

paragraphs.en: "Ten years."
paragraphs.zh: “十岁。”

paragraphs.en: "So young, and yet, I regret to say, so deceitful," Mrs. Reed continued coldly. "I desire that she be trained in habits of strict discipline and humility at Lowood School."
paragraphs.zh: “这么年轻，然而，我很遗憾地说，这么狡诈，”里德太太冷酷地继续道。“我希望她在罗伍德学校接受严格纪律和谦逊习惯的训练。”

paragraphs.en: Mr. Brocklehurst nodded gravely. "Imparting habits of mortification of the flesh is our special duty at Lowood," he declared.
paragraphs.zh: 博克勒赫斯特先生严肃地点头。“传授克制肉体的习惯是我们在罗伍德的特殊职责，”他声明。

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Arrival at Lowood Institution
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：抵达罗伍德慈善学校

paragraphs.en: 5 o'clock struck from the bell of the school tower as the coach pulled up at the heavy iron gates of Lowood Institution.
paragraphs.zh: 当马车停在罗伍德机构沉重的铁门前时，学校钟楼的钟声敲响了五点。

paragraphs.en: Rain was falling heavily, and the wind blew in bitter gusts across the desolate moorland.
paragraphs.zh: 大雨磅礴，风在荒凉的荒野上阵阵苦吹。

paragraphs.en: I stepped out of the coach, shivering with cold, carrying my small trunk. A tall, pale lady with a kind, sorrowful face met me at the door and led me into the long, dimly lit hall.
paragraphs.zh: 我拎着我的小行李箱，因寒冷而发抖地走出马车。一位高大、苍白、长着温和悲伤脸庞的女士在门口迎接我，带我进入漫长、昏暗的大厅。

paragraphs.en: "I am Miss Temple, the superintendent," she said gently, laying a warm hand on my shoulder. "You must be cold and tired after your long journey, Jane."
paragraphs.zh: “我是校长泰姆普尔小姐，”她温和地说，把一只温暖的手放在我的肩膀上。“经过长途旅行，简，你一定又冷又累。”

paragraphs.en: She took me to a large, bare room where eighty girls, dressed in plain brown frocks and linen aprons, sat at long wooden tables, silently reading their lesson books by the dim light of tallow candles.
paragraphs.zh: 她把我带到一个巨大的、简陋的房间，八十个穿着朴素棕色连衣裙和麻布围裙的女孩坐在长木桌旁，在牛脂蜡烛昏暗的光线下默默地读着她们的课本。
